author: TeIq
content: Origin: #30 dispatch was explicitly scoped to file-plain only. The three other custody modes' rotation paths (passphrase_sealed write_sealed-via-rotation, os_keychain entry replace, cloud_kms_oracle key-id alias swap) need their own dispatch. Shape: extend RotationContext::write_new_key_material with mode-specific implementations; unit-test each in isolation; integrate with the existing state machine without changing its surface.
